method: Three-day scripted review: school/rain weekday, guests/work day, maintenance/storm/20-year scenario. Not measured behaviour or engineering simulation.

scenarios.design_response: Garage unloading 2.4 x4.2m; six lockers, stowed folding bench, separate pedestrians, then essential lift. Six people queue; not six abreast.
scenarios.limits: Two car doors + walking route checked; weather cover, gate sequencing and actual road remain unresolved.

scenarios.design_response: Car -> unloading -> lift -> nearby5m² pantry -> screened kitchen. Use pantry as initial drop; fridge leg is longer.
scenarios.limits: Lift/pantry and stair/kitchen paths checked; no claim of an8m complete grocery route or guaranteed lift capacity.

scenarios.design_response: Unload gear in garage before lift; four separate bag bays; washable lower laundry near both child rooms.
scenarios.limits: Actual wet storage/boot drying ventilation and six-bike product capacity need design.

scenarios.design_response: Exactly three WCs. Routine child use of one lower shared squat; parents private seated WC not overflow capacity.
scenarios.limits: Four 3min WC visits arriving2min apart produce waits0/1/2/3min. Basin within WC shares lock; waiting is real and accepted, not eliminated.

scenarios.design_response: One routine child shower below; upper shared shower is not counted as a second child fixture for queue claims.
scenarios.limits: Example8min showers at06:20/30/40/50 finish06:58. Not a household observation or DHW sizing.

scenarios.design_response: Opaque service return and west WC approach, not a closed toilet leaf; screened kitchen has two usable indoor portals.
scenarios.limits: All living-seat posture rays and kitchen living/dining rays checked. Standing service-corridor and reflective surfaces remain separate.

scenarios.design_response: Separate road-tier room with acoustic door, away from lower sleep corridor.
scenarios.limits: No measured acoustic rating; isolate plant vibration and garage impact noise.

scenarios.design_response: NE open reading bay; same-floor seated wudu via indoor family route.
scenarios.limits: 600mm walking proxy checked; Qibla and fixture direction setting-out unresolved; not a dedicated room.

scenarios.design_response: Direct lower lounge door at1670.00 -> level link -> flat soil garden. Garden stair only links upper/lower outdoor levels.
scenarios.limits: Children can reach bedrooms without entering parents suite; guard/gates/drainage/support not engineered.

scenarios.design_response: Both shared child rooms on same lower level as7.04m² laundry; parents bring laundry down via lift.
scenarios.limits: Avoid claiming all bedrooms next to laundry: parents are now upstairs; measured route trade-off retained.

scenarios.design_response: Lower guest/quiet room and garden lounge acoustically separable from upper parents and main living.
scenarios.limits: Doors/envelope need an acoustic specification. Parents upstairs trade east bedroom view for fewer essential level changes.

scenarios.design_response: Lower17.48m² guest room, lift to daily living; upper private parents bathroom has only seated toilet.
scenarios.limits: Not independently wheelchair-accessible guest accommodation: using parents ensuite crosses their bedroom. No extra WC silently added.

scenarios.design_response: Upper parents suite, kitchen/dining/living, seated toilet/shower and terrace all on one principal level.
scenarios.limits: Road-to-upper lift essential from day1; power failure and assisted fire escape unresolved. Squat shared WCs not accessible substitutes.

scenarios.design_response: Kitchen sorting -> lift/garage collection; outdoor serviced bin location by approach still needs actual authority/product layout.
scenarios.limits: No bin store in car sweeps or public road. Final external location remains null.

scenarios.design_response: Road-tier plant west replacement door1.2m -> clear unloading -> garage opening.
scenarios.limits: Walking clearance is not a pallet/large-equipment replacement certification; product sizes and valves remain unknown.

scenarios.design_response: Independent lower WC entry hidden from lounge, small snack sink/fridge reservation; parents private upper bath.
scenarios.limits: Night lighting, basin lock queue and closed-door acoustics need specification.

scenarios.design_response: Independent roof overflow and retaining/surface-water collection proposed; no reliance on a single garage trench drain.
scenarios.limits: Cannot pass storm failure test without road levels, rainfall, outlet invert, lawful overflow route and pump strategy.

scenarios.design_response: Bedroom external aperture reservations and level lower garden exit; independent pedestrian gate and garden stair.
scenarios.limits: Keyless single-action release required as intent. Fire road, detection, separation, rescue openings, WUI and assisted escape need professionals.

scenarios.design_response: Essential2.1 x2.2m gross lift reservation and1.525m bathroom circle; clear upper routes drawn.
scenarios.limits: Disc routes and circle do not prove companion turning, side transfer, safe evacuation, door approaches or selected equipment.

scenarios.design_response: Two beds, two1.4m desks and two1.5m wardrobes per child room; parents on living level; guest room provides later flexibility.
scenarios.limits: Two shared child rooms retained. Conversion to four single bedrooms is not claimed; lift maintenance and shared-WC preference remain long-term decisions.
